## load the data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
gee_long_all_bx <- readRDS("../artifacts/gee_long_all_bx.rds")
```

verify data

```{r}
names(gee_long_all_bx)
```

```{r}
unique(gee_long_all_bx$structure)
unique(gee_long_all_bx$motivation)
unique(gee_long_all_bx$InfoType)
unique(gee_long_all_bx$InfoImportance)
unique(gee_long_all_bx$Behavior)

table(gee_long_all_bx$Behavior, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
summary(gee_long_all_bx$Count)

table(gee_long_all_bx$Count, useNA = "ifany")
```

\

```{r}
participant_behavior_props <- gee_long_all_bx %>%
  group_by(
    ResponseId,
    structure,
    motivation,
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TotalClues = sum(Count),
    Proportion = Count / TotalClues
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

verify

correct number of clues per participant, 3 in each category

```{r}
participant_behavior_props %>%
  distinct(
    ResponseId,
    structure,
    motivation,
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    TotalClues
  ) %>%
  count(
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    TotalClues
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    TotalClues
  )
```

proportions sum to 1

```{r}
participant_behavior_props %>%
  group_by(
    ResponseId,
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalProportion = sum(Proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  count(TotalProportion)
```

descriptive stats

```{r}
behavior_summary <- participant_behavior_props %>%
  group_by(
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    structure,
    motivation,
    Behavior
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    M = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

format

```{r}
behavior_table <- behavior_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `M (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", M, SD)
  ) %>%
  select(
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    structure,
    motivation,
    Behavior,
    `M (SD)`
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = `M (SD)`
  )
```

```{r}
behavior_table <- behavior_summary %>%
  mutate(
    InfoType = recode(
      InfoType,
      "public" = "Public",
      "private" = "Private"
    ),
    InfoImportance = recode(
      InfoImportance,
      "more" = "More Important",
      "less" = "Less Important"
    ),
    structure = recode(
      structure,
      "individual" = "Interindividual",
      "group" = "Intergroup"
    ),
    motivation = recode(
      motivation,
      "proself" = "Proself",
      "prosocial" = "Prosocial"
    ),
    Behavior = recode(
      Behavior,
      "shared" = "Shared",
      "withheld" = "Withheld",
      "distort" = "Distorted"
    ),
    `M (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", M, SD)
  ) %>%
  select(
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    structure,
    motivation,
    Behavior,
    `M (SD)`
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = `M (SD)`
  )

behavior_table
```

sorted

```{r}
behavior_table_sorted <- behavior_summary %>%
  mutate(
    structure = recode(
      structure,
      "group" = "Intergroup",
      "individual" = "Interindividual"
    ),
    motivation = recode(
      motivation,
      "proself" = "Proself",
      "prosocial" = "Prosocial"
    ),
    InfoType = recode(
      InfoType,
      "public" = "Common",
      "private" = "Unique"
    ),
    InfoImportance = recode(
      InfoImportance,
      "less" = "Low",
      "more" = "High"
    ),
    Behavior = recode(
      Behavior,
      "shared" = "Share",
      "withheld" = "Withhold",
      "distort" = "Distort"
    ),

    Condition = paste(structure, motivation, sep = ", "),

    Condition = factor(
      Condition,
      levels = c(
        "Intergroup, Proself",
        "Intergroup, Prosocial",
        "Interindividual, Proself",
        "Interindividual, Prosocial"
      )
    ),

    InfoType = factor(
      InfoType,
      levels = c("Common", "Unique")
    ),

    InfoImportance = factor(
      InfoImportance,
      levels = c("Low", "High")
    ),

    `M (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", M, SD)
  )
```

```{r}
names(behavior_table_sorted)
```

```{r}
unique(behavior_table_sorted$Behavior)
```

```{r}
behavior_table_sorted <- behavior_table_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    InformationType = paste(InfoType, InfoImportance, sep = ", ")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance,
    InformationType,
    Behavior,
    `M (SD)`
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = `M (SD)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Condition,
    InfoType,
    InfoImportance
  ) %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    InformationType,
    Share,
    Withhold,
    Distort
  )
```

```{r}
condition_n <- participant_behavior_props %>%
  distinct(
    ResponseId,
    structure,
    motivation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    structure = recode(
      structure,
      "group" = "Intergroup",
      "individual" = "Interindividual"
    ),
    motivation = recode(
      motivation,
      "proself" = "Proself",
      "prosocial" = "Prosocial"
    ),
    Condition = paste(structure, motivation, sep = ", ")
  ) %>%
  count(
    Condition,
    name = "n"
  )
```

```{r}
behavior_table_sorted <- behavior_table_sorted %>%
  left_join(
    condition_n,
    by = "Condition"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Condition,
    n,
    InformationType,
    Share,
    Withhold,
    Distort
  )
```

```{r}
behavior_table_sorted
```
